overview.message: Agent mode on Prometheus reads PromQL through queryReadOnly, and the object tree, health, storage and table readings from the server's own read endpoints. The overview's connection ceiling is read from the server's command-line flags. Agent mode does not read the server's command-line flags: they carry file paths, listen addresses, URLs and local configuration, so they are withheld on every agent-mode reading. This is Studio's choice, not the server's answer. So no overview is taken; the version and the uptime are in the health reading and in PromQL (prometheus_build_info, process_start_time_seconds).
